events.label: independence
events.text: Cospaia declared independence after an unmentioned strip escaped the Florence sale.

events.label: recognition
events.text: Florence and the Papal States formally recognized Cospaia's autonomy.

evidence.quote: In 1484 its autonomy was formally recognized by both Florence and the Papal States

events.text: Council moved its meetings from the Valenti house to the Church of the Annunciation.

evidence.quote: in the Valenti house until 1718 , when the council began to meet in the Church of the Annunciation

events.text: Cospaia was divided between Tuscany and the Papal States by treaty.

evidence.quote: On May 25 , 1826 , Cospaia was divided between Tuscany and the Papal States

events.text: Cospaia submitted by act and became part of the Papal States.

evidence.quote: on 26 June 1826 , with an act of submission by fourteen representatives of the republic
